postReview.title: Aston Villa 1-2 Nottingham Forest: Delap and Igor Jesus strike to seal late victory
postReview.description: Igor Jesus scored a late winner over Aston Villa, helping Nottingham Forest to their first Premier League win of the season.

postReview.title: Aston Villa 1-2 Nottingham Forest: Delap e Igor Jesus sellan con sus goles un triunfo agónico
postReview.description: Igor Jesus marcó en el tramo final ante el Aston Villa y dio al Nottingham Forest su primera victoria de la temporada en la Premier League.

postReview.title: Aston Villa-Nottingham Forest 1-2: Delap a segno, Igor Jesus decide nel finale
postReview.description: Igor Jesus decide nel finale contro l'Aston Villa e regala al Nottingham Forest la prima vittoria stagionale in Premier League.

postReview.title: Aston Villa 1 x 2 Nottingham Forest: Delap e Igor Jesus marcam e garantem vitória no fim
postReview.description: Igor Jesus marca no fim contra o Aston Villa e garante ao Nottingham Forest a primeira vitória nesta edição da Premier League.

postReview.title: Aston Villa 1-2 Nottingham Forest : Delap et Igor Jesus offrent la victoire à Forest en fin de match
postReview.description: Igor Jesus offre à Nottingham Forest son premier succès de la saison en Premier League face à Aston Villa.

postReview.title: Aston Villa 1:2 Nottingham Forest: Delap und Igor Jesus sichern späten Sieg
postReview.description: Igor Jesus erzielte gegen Aston Villa den späten Siegtreffer und bescherte Nottingham Forest den ersten Premier-League-Sieg der Saison.

postReview.title: أستون فيلا 1-2 نوتنغهام فورست: ديلاب وإيغور جيسوس يقودان فورست إلى انتصار قاتل
postReview.description: إيغور جيسوس يسجل هدفاً قاتلاً أمام أستون فيلا ويمنح نوتنغهام فورست فوزه الأول في الدوري الإنجليزي هذا الموسم

postReview.title: Aston Villa 1-2 Nottingham Forest: Delap e Igor Jesus marcam no triunfo selado nos instantes finais
postReview.description: Igor Jesus marcou o golo da vitória perto do fim frente ao Aston Villa e deu ao Nottingham Forest o primeiro triunfo na Premier League esta época.

preReview.title: Emery hopes Champions League win will give Aston Villa confidence
preReview.description: Aston Villa won their Champions League opener, and they will be hoping to get on the board in the Premier League against Nottingham Forest.

preReview.title: Emery confía en que el triunfo en la Champions League refuerce la confianza del Aston Villa
preReview.description: El Aston Villa ganó en su estreno en la Champions League y buscará su primera victoria en la Premier League ante el Nottingham Forest.

preReview.title: Emery spera che il successo in Champions League dia fiducia all'Aston Villa
preReview.description: L'Aston Villa ha vinto all'esordio in Champions League e ora cerca il primo successo in Premier League contro il Nottingham Forest.

preReview.title: Emery espera que vitória na Champions dê confiança ao Aston Villa
preReview.description: O Aston Villa venceu na estreia da Liga dos Campeões e agora busca seus primeiros pontos na Premier League contra o Nottingham Forest.

preReview.title: Emery espère que la victoire en Ligue des champions rendra confiance à Aston Villa
preReview.description: Vainqueur de son premier match de Ligue des champions, Aston Villa veut débloquer son compteur en Premier League face à Nottingham Forest.

preReview.title: إيمري يأمل أن يمنح فوز دوري الأبطال أستون فيلا دفعة معنوية
preReview.description: افتتح أستون فيلا مشواره بدوري أبطال أوروبا بالفوز، ويأمل في حصد أول نقاطه بالدوري الإنجليزي أمام نوتنغهام فورست.

preReview.title: Emery hofft nach Aston Villas Champions-League-Sieg auf neues Selbstvertrauen
preReview.description: Nach dem Sieg zum Champions-League-Auftakt will Aston Villa gegen Nottingham Forest auch die ersten Premier-League-Punkte holen.

preReview.title: Emery espera que a vitória na Liga dos Campeões dê confiança ao Aston Villa
preReview.description: O Aston Villa estreou-se com uma vitória na Liga dos Campeões e procura agora o primeiro triunfo na Premier League diante do Nottingham Forest.
